description: Supplier CUIT fails the check-digit validation
Supplier not found in the supplier master
Exact duplicate (same CUIT, type, point of sale and number)
Possible duplicate: same supplier and total within 7 days
IVA rate not allowed or IVA amount does not match net x rate
Total does not equal net + IVA + other taxes
No purchase order on an invoice above ARS 250,000
Unit price above the purchase order price by more than 2%
Invoiced quantity above quantity received (goods receipt)
Invoice type inconsistent with the supplier's tax status
CAE missing, malformed or expired at invoice date
Invoice date in the future or due date before invoice date
